data.one_liner: Firebase Cloud Messaging integration for awesome_notifications push features
data.what_it_does: Enables sending rich push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging using all of the awesome_notifications layout features, images, and sounds. It serves as a replacement for the standard firebase_messaging plugin.
use_when: You want to use Firebase Cloud Messaging to send rich push notifications with custom layouts, buttons, and sounds via awesome_notifications.
You are replacing firebase_messaging with awesome_notifications_fcm to unify your push and local notification handling.
avoid_when: You are already using the standard firebase_messaging plugin alongside this one (they conflict and you must not use both).
You do not need Firebase and only require local notifications.
strengths: Integrates full awesome_notifications feature set (images, layouts, buttons, sounds) with Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Allows dismissing and cancelling notifications remotely by ID, Group ID, or Channel ID.
Supports silent push notifications for background instructions and topic subscriptions.
weaknesses: Requires complex native iOS configuration including a Notification Service Extension target and pod modifications.
Not compatible with firebase_messaging; requires migrating away from it if it was previously used.
Push notifications are not 100% reliable and can be impacted by battery saving modes.
data.setup_notes: Requires flutterfire CLI configuration, Android setup, and advanced iOS setup including adding a Notification Service Extension target in Xcode, modifying the Podfile, and configuring specific build settings.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the official, standard Firebase messaging plugin without the added features and native setup complexity of awesome_notifications.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a dedicated third-party push notification platform with advanced targeting and built-in dashboard analytics rather than raw FCM.
